biggest_catch: 'Honey Gold' was renamed PayPal Rewards — earnings are points, not automatic cash, and you need 1,000 points to redeem a gift card in the US plus a PayPal account in good standing to convert points to cash.
catches: Reward rates vary by merchant and offer; points earnings are not guaranteed income.
Only eligible purchases earn points; many categories and gift-card purchases are excluded.
US gift-card redemption requires 1,000 points; smaller balances cannot be redeemed.
Gift cards are delivered by email within 24 hours of redemption; delays happen.
Purchases must be tracked through Honey — ad blockers or broken attribution can mean no points.
Honey tracks your shopping activity across sites to find deals — a real privacy trade-off.

c1.evidence: PayPal Honey is a real product from PayPal; payout facts verified on paypal.com and the official help.joinhoney.com help center.

c2.evidence: Official PayPal guide to using PayPal Honey and Honey help articles document earning PayPal Rewards points and redeeming them to PayPal or gift cards.

c3.evidence: No upfront fee to install Honey or join PayPal Rewards.

c4.evidence: Official help: eligible purchases earn PayPal Rewards points, redeemable through a linked PayPal account in good standing or for gift cards; the US gift-card threshold is 1,000 points; gift cards are emailed within 24 hours.

eligibility: US residents 18+ with a PayPal account in good standing; Honey browser extension installed.

steps: Install the PayPal Honey browser extension and create or link your PayPal account (keep it in good standing).
Shop at eligible stores with Honey activated so purchases are tracked.
Earn PayPal Rewards points on eligible purchases.
Once you have enough points (1,000 points for a US gift card), redeem through your linked PayPal account for cash or choose a gift card.
Watch for the gift-card email within 24 hours of redemption.
